app.tagline: A quiet place to look back on the year, and to thank each other.
lang.label: Language
landing.title: Aloha
landing.body: This is where {hui} does its yearly reflection. You write about your own year and about a few coworkers, then {director} reads it all and sits down with each person to talk story.
landing.howto: To get started, open the link {director} sent you by text or email. It brings you straight to your list.
landing.expired: That link has expired or is no longer active.
landing.newlink: Need a fresh link? Ask {director} for a new one.
landing.offline: We could not reach the server. Check your signal and try again.
dash.none: No review is open right now. Mahalo for checking in.
dash.offline: You are offline. Anything you write is saved on this phone and will sync later.
card.quickDone: Quick version done, come back for the rest.
review.anon: Anonymous. Your name is never stored with this answer.
review.anonMahalo: Anonymous unless you check the box to sign it.
review.selfNote: These are your own words about your year.
review.sign: Sign my name to this mahalo so they know it came from me
review.placeholder: Type here, or tap Talk and say it out loud
review.recording: Recording {time} of 3:00. Tap Stop when you are done.
review.transcribed: Here is what we heard. Fix anything that is off.
review.audioQueued: Recording saved on this phone. It will turn into words when you are back online.
review.transcribeFailed: We kept your recording but could not turn it into words, so {director} can still listen to it.
review.noMic: We could not use the microphone. You can type instead.
review.savedLocal: Saved on this phone, will sync when online
review.required: This one needs an answer, by typing or talking.
review.missing: {n} question(s) still need an answer before this is done.
review.doneBody: Your answers are in. You can come back and change them until the review closes.
review.quickDoneBody: Quick version done. Come back for the rest when you have more time.
review.closed: This review is closed, so answers can no longer change.
me.title: Your summaries
me.none: Nothing has been shared with you yet.
me.reflectHelp: Write back to {director}. What landed, what surprised you, what you want to add.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.load: We could not load this page. Check your signal and try again.
error.login: Please open your link again to continue.
error.storage: This browser would not save your answer. Copy it somewhere safe.
